newsitem.title: USA: CBOT corn called up 1/2 to one cent on weather.
newsitem.headline: CBOT corn called up 1/2 to one cent on weather.

text.p: CBOT corn futures were expected to open 1/2 to one cent per bushel higher on forecasts for rain in the eastern Corn Belt, traders said.
"They're supposed to get rain Friday, Saturday and Sunday in the east," said one floor trader. "They're still talking about replanting."
Soils in parts of the eastern Corn Belt are already saturated, so more rain is viewed as a hindrance to the developing corn crop, traders said.
Expected gains in CBOT soybean futures were also seen pushing corn prices higher on the open.
